          if (idx === focusableArray.length - 1) {
            e.preventDefault();
            focusableArray[0].focus();
          }
        }
      }

  };
  confirmModal.addEventListener('keydown', keydownHandler);
});
confirmModal.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal', () => {
  if (keydownHandler) {
    confirmModal.removeEventListener('keydown', keydownHandler);
    keydownHandler = null;
  }
});
